screen.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a highly polished PC action roguelite game's three-choice build reward selection interface. Single full screen mockup, widescreen 16:9, crisp high resolution. The game's visual language is a realistic enchanted sunlit forest with ancient limestone ruins, ivy, warm light shafts, moss, elegant Chinese fantasy typography. It has a dark forest-green and antique gold UI. Art direction: "林庭秘契". Mature restrained premium game UI, tangible slightly worn dark jade/enamel panels, beautifully engraved brushed pale gold narrow edging, sparse tiny botanical leaf ornaments only at card corners, small gemstone details. Readability before decoration. This is a screen UI, not a photographed physical card or mobile gacha.
Layout: cinematic blurred dim forest courtyard backdrop; small thin gold decorative header centered top with large exact Chinese heading "选择你的成长"; smaller subtitle "选择一项祝福，强化本次冒险". THREE large equally sized vertical collectible blessing cards across center, ample separation, each taking about 23% of screen width, 66% of screen height. Straight-on perfectly aligned grid, no perspective or fanning. Each card uses upper 40% for a detailed full-width painterly realistic fantasy illustration softly dissolving into its dark evergreen text panel, not a circular icon. Thick enough text areas for comfortable legibility. Rarity small top badge; name below art large ivory serif; compact action pill below title; very clearly emphasized primary effect in larger colored numerals; secondary explanatory lines; bottom softly recessed "选择此祝福" button integrated into card. All cards same size and architecture. Body copy in clean readable Chinese, labels exact, no gibberish or extra copy.
LEFT: ordinary rarity, silver-white rim, understated brushed silver corners. Badge "普通". Illustration a curved steel nodachi sword sweeping a broad silver-green arc through leaves in the forest, no person needed. Name "长刃". Action pill "左键 · 普攻". Small status "新能力". Key stat "攻击范围 +25%". Below "扩大近战打击范围". Footer "选择此祝福".
MIDDLE: rare rarity, fine sapphire blue rim, pale gold botanical details, subtly brighter focus outline and four delicate corner markers, NOT neon bloom. Illustration a low icy blue blade wave leaving a frost-coated winding trail over old mossy stone pavers, recognizable winter magic on forest floor. Badge "稀有". Name "霜径". Pill "右键 · 剑气". Small status "新能力". Key stat "霜径持续 3 秒". Smaller lines "剑气沿途留下冰霜" and "减缓敌人移动". Small muted requirement chip "需要冰系剑气". Footer "选择此祝福".
RIGHT: epic rarity, violet-amethyst fine rim and sparse antique gold corners. Illustration a sharp steel slash shattering crystalline ice on a dark forest backdrop, recognizable icy frozen target silhouette, mature realistic painted game illustration, no gore. Badge "史诗". Name "乘隙斩". Pill "左键 · 普攻". Small status "新能力". Key stat "追击伤害 +50%". Smaller lines "攻击其他动作冻住的敌人" and "强化这一次近战命中". Footer "选择此祝福".
Below all cards a single centered medium-width refined jade green button with engraved gold double-arrow circular refresh icon and exact text "刷新选项"; small muted caption "重新生成本次候选". No invented currency costs or free refresh counts. No current build sidebar, no technical notes, no HUD clutter. Restrained rim glows only, soft bevel shadows, panel opacity high, body text ivory. Keep background dim and atmospheric so text is exceptionally readable. Every label precisely legible. No logos, no watermark.

rarity.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create the companion rarity-frame design sheet for the UI in the reference image. Reference image role: approved-for-comparison style and component geometry reference, not a background to copy. Precisely preserve its elegant rectangular dark evergreen enamel card panels, slim engraved botanical corners, slightly beveled antique metal and compact top trapezoid rarity badge. Build a single widescreen 16:9 high-resolution professional UI component artboard on a simple very dark charcoal-forest-green background. Four equally sized vertical card frames in one row, clearly separated, straight-on view and consistent identical geometry. Heading small tasteful ivory serif Chinese: "林庭秘契 · 四档品质". From left to right badges read exactly "普通", "稀有", "史诗", "传说". Common is silver-white metal, sparse leaf etching and no glow. Rare has sapphire blue inset edge, pale gold corner leaves and a tiny blue top jewel. Epic has rich amethyst inset edge, pale antique gold botanical corners, tiny violet jewel and restrained purple edge light. Legendary has amber-orange inner edge, softly luminous antique gold framing, a small complete gilded leaf crest at top and small amber gem, the richest detailing yet still slim and restrained. Common, rare and epic should closely match the reference UI, legendary should look like its natural fourth tier. Interior card content is intentionally EMPTY for future dynamic game UI: a large calm empty dark green art region at the top, a subtle thin separator, a dark muted green text area at bottom; absolutely no placeholder lorem ipsum, symbols, drawn lines imitating text, abilities, stats or illustrations. At base of each card an integrated BLANK recessed rectangular button with chamfered corners. Leave enough vertical space for a two-line title and four lines of text in future, never consume text space with decoration. Below all four, centered, one matching jade green gold-rim refresh button with clear circular double arrow icon and exact text "刷新选项". Show refined material shading and sparse botanical motifs, crisp contours, minimal soft glow, legible Chinese text. This is a design comparison sheet, not a full game screenshot. No transparency checkerboard, no environment scene, no logos, no watermark. Do not add any fifth card.

notes: Design preview, no Godot runtime changes. Card copy shortened for layout; refresh economics unspecified; legendary frame is future UI only.
